description: This file defines a React functional component called TopBar, which implements a navigation bar with menu items, handles selection, and supports optional right-aligned content. It manages the rendering of menu buttons with accessibility attributes and visual styling based on the selected item.

methods.name: TopBar({ menus, selected, onMenuSelect, children })
